echo.desc_en: Echo, a mountain nymph of ancient Greek myth, a slender young woman about 18 years old, long wavy light brown hair with a few small green leaves in it, a pale sage-green ankle-length chiton that fully covers her chest, shoulders and arms to the elbow, a soft grey-green himation shawl, simple leather sandals, shy gentle grey eyes, no crown, no jewelry except a thin leaf circlet

narcissus.desc_en: Narcissus, a beautiful youth of ancient Greek myth about 16 years old, short wavy dark blond hair, fair face with long eyelashes, a white knee-length chiton that fully covers his chest and shoulders, a dark blue chlamys cloak pinned at one shoulder, leather sandals laced to the shin, a light hunting spear, proud cool expression (Classical Greek period)
